# Repository instructions

This repository is a small C++ endianness demonstration, not a production OS/400 application or an existing knowledge platform.

For Squad work, follow `.squad/policies/planning-only.md`, `.squad/mission.md`, `.squad/team.md` and `.squad/routing.md`. Current authorization is discovery and phased design only. Preserve `src/`, `CMakeLists.txt` and original guides. Do not install/upgrade dependencies, create issues/workflows/commits, push, provision services, start watchers or read `.env` files. Do not transmit repository code externally or persist secrets/user emails. Ralph is configured but dormant.

Use installed local tools for checks; distinguish native ARM64 results from unperformed x86/IBM i validation. Cite source paths and line spans. Histories and audit trails are append-only. Templates are reference material, not authorization to run their commands.
